description:
The engine hardcodes vocabulary that repositories and profiles declare, and production code reads a test-only environment variable to switch off a git branch guard that compares against a literal `origin/main`. This epic binds every such value to its declaration or deletes it, so a repository that declares nothing gets nothing.

## Background

Hardcoded repository vocabulary, verified at `79c177fbd`:

- `jit issue reject --reason` writes the label `format!("resolution:{}", …)` (`crates/jit/src/main.rs:3955`). The `resolution` namespace is declared by the shipped default profile (`profiles/jit-default/manifest.toml:164`), not by the engine.
- `extract_hard_criteria` collects lines starting with the literal `[hard]` (`crates/jit/src/commands/template_expand.rs:654-665`). Criterion markers are declared per item kind (`markers` under `[item_kinds.<kind>]`, `crates/jit/src/config.rs:525-528`), so a repository declaring another marker gets an empty `{container.hard_criteria}`.
- `LinkValidator::is_permanent_path` treats `docs/`, `README.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `LICENSE` and `dev/architecture/` as permanent (`crates/jit/src/document/link_validator.rs:202-211`), beside the declared registry `DocumentationConfig::permanent_paths()` (`crates/jit/src/config.rs:387`).
- `suggest_label_fix` always suggests `component:<label>` (`crates/jit/src/labels.rs:77-85`), whether or not the repository declares a `component` namespace.
- `query_strategic` falls back to every type at hierarchy level 1 or 2 when `strategic_types` is undeclared (`crates/jit/src/commands/query.rs:60-71`).
- The web graph picks level 2 as its cluster level, commented "typically epic" (`web/src/utils/subgraphClustering.ts:63-66`). The unimported module `web/src/types/hierarchy.ts` repeats `level <= 2` (`:44`).
- The snapshot README lists `docs/` and `dev/` as snapshot structure (`crates/jit/src/commands/snapshot.rs:426-427`). That is this repository's own layout.

Test hook and branch guard:

- Production code reads `JIT_TEST_MODE` at three sites: the main-history guard (`crates/jit/src/commands/worktree.rs:451`) and two claims-index checks (`crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs:1906`, `crates/jit/src/validation/repository.rs:549`).
- The main-history guard runs on gate define, update and remove (`crates/jit/src/commands/gate.rs:1167,1216,1312,1327`). It compares `HEAD` with the literal `origin/main` by spawning `git` in the process working directory, not the invocation's repository (`crates/jit/src/commands/worktree.rs:388-418`). Its rustdoc claims a `cfg(test)` skip the code does not perform (`worktree.rs:434-437`), and a public doctest sets `JIT_TEST_MODE` to bypass it (`gate.rs:1276`).
- `jit validate --branch-drift` hardcodes `origin/main` the same way (`crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs:2737-2761`; help text `crates/jit/src/cli.rs:402`; message `crates/jit/src/main.rs:7549`). The shipped pre-commit hook compares against `origin/main` or `main` (`scripts/hooks/pre-commit:37-45`).
- Configuration accepts `[global_operations] require_main_history` and `allowed_branches` (`crates/jit/src/config.rs:1376-1389`); the guard reads neither.

Three candidates are mechanism vocabulary under `@/inv/domain-agnostic` and stay: the `type` namespace (`labels::TYPE_NAMESPACE`), which the type-hierarchy mechanism resolves; the default icon per hierarchy level (`crates/jit/src/type_icons.rs`), an overridable default applied only to declared types; and the engine's own storage paths under the data root.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No production source in `crates/`, `web/` or the shipped hooks names a label namespace, rule name, type name, hierarchy level, criterion marker, branch or documentation path that a repository or profile declares. Each such value is read from the repository's declarations.
- [hard] REQ-02: `issue reject --reason` records the reason under a namespace the repository declares for that role. In a repository that declares none, `--reason` fails with an error naming the missing declaration and writes nothing.
- [hard] REQ-04: `{container.hard_criteria}` expands to the container's criteria carrying the markers its repository declares. A repository declaring a different marker gets its marked criteria; one declaring no markers gets an empty block.
- [hard] REQ-05: A root-relative link is classified permanent exactly when its path falls under the declared permanent paths.
- [hard] REQ-06: Label-format suggestions name only namespaces the repository declares.
- [hard] REQ-07: `query strategic` returns exactly the issues whose type is a declared strategic type, and an empty list when none is declared. The level-based fallback is deleted.
- [hard] REQ-08: The web graph chooses its cluster container from the hierarchy resolution the server serves or from the declared strategic types. `web/src` contains no hierarchy-level literal.
- [hard] REQ-09: The snapshot README describes only what that snapshot contains, derived from its manifest.
- [hard] REQ-10: No production source reads `JIT_TEST_MODE`. Whether the branch guard and the claims-index check run is decided by inputs on the executor or layout a caller constructs, and tests set those inputs on the executor they build.
- [hard] REQ-11: Every branch comparison the product performs (the gate-registry guard, `validate --branch-drift`, the shipped pre-commit hook) takes its base branch from one repository declaration and runs git against the invocation's repository. With no declaration, the comparison does not run and reports that no base branch is declared. Deleting a comparison outright also meets this criterion.
- [hard] REQ-12: Rustdoc, help text and messages for the branch comparisons describe what the code does; no `cfg(test)` or `origin/main` claim remains.
- [hard] REQ-13: Each rebound site has a test over declarations that differ from this repository's (another marker, rule name, namespace, strategic type set, permanent path set, base branch) and a test over a repository that declares none.

## Notes

- Background line references are as of `79c177fbd`. Current locations, and the claims already met since (no `JIT_TEST_MODE` reader, `web/src/types/hierarchy.ts` and `[global_operations]` deleted, guard and drift check run git against the served repository), are recorded in `dev/active/f368ce3d-domain-agnostic-engine/investigation.md`.
- `jit issue create --orphan` was removed in 5d5a1794 (steward ruling 2026-11-04), so the former orphan-flag criterion no longer applies.
Serves `@/inv/domain-agnostic`: a site is mechanism when its assertion and membership derive from what the repository declares and it produces nothing when the repository declares nothing. Also `@/charter/D-18` (delete a guard or fallback in preference to rewiring it), `@/charter/D-21` (git through the storage-owned git module), `@/charter/D-4` (git stays optional), `@/inv/architecture-dependency-direction` (test switches arrive as inputs, not ambient environment) and `@/inv/canonical-cutover` (unread configuration keys are removed, not kept beside a new declaration).

The test-side race on the environment variable is out of scope; this epic removes the production reads.
title: Take engine vocabulary and test switches only from declarations and caller inputs
